resources.string: Live captions of the sound of this device, made on this device by Whisper, or in the cloud. The captions go to your share link, where the viewers read along with Yomitan, and to SubRead Overlay over the player.
On this phone: free, and no sound leaves the phone
In the cloud: a larger model, better captions, less battery. It costs hours.
In the cloud, each piece of sound goes to subread.space and to DeepInfra, which make the text. subread.space keeps neither the sound nor the text, and DeepInfra says that it does not store them.
